在自己电脑上安装并运行 Marker，再选择转换结果。StudyHub 只提供脚: Install and run Marker on your computer, then select its output. StudyHub provides a script and imports the result; it does not install or start Marker.
按官方指南准备 Python 环境并安装 marker-pdf。建议使用独立虚拟: Follow the official guide to prepare Python and install marker-pdf. Use a separate virtual environment and check the system and hardware requirements for your chosen version.
一键下载转换脚本，保存后在该 Python 环境中运行以下命令，按提示选择本地: Download the conversion script, save it, and run this command in that Python environment. Follow its prompt to select a local PDF.
转换结束后，脚本会显示结果文件路径。点击下面的按钮，在文件选择器中找到该路径下的: After conversion, the script shows the output file path. Use the button below to find its paginated Markdown in the file picker; your computer is not scanned.
首次运行可能下载模型，需要网络、磁盘空间与等待时间。脚本只调用本地转换，不启用: The first run may download models and needs a network connection, disk space and time. The script runs local conversion, leaves LLM enhancement off, and does not read StudyHub model settings.
Marker 代码采用 Apache-2.0，模型权重有独立许可与使用条件；仅提: Marker code uses Apache-2.0. Model weights have separate licenses and usage conditions; using a script does not remove these requirements. Check them before use.
与 MinerU 的效果因资料而异；本地转换耗时和内存取决于设备。导入后请核对公: Results compared with MinerU depend on the document; local conversion time and memory depend on your device. Check formulas, tables, reading order and page numbers after import. Image files are not imported automatically with Markdown.
Marker 2 的 OCR 后端还需按官方指南准备 Docker / NVID: Marker 2 OCR also needs backend dependencies such as Docker / NVIDIA or llama-server; follow the official guide. Installing the Python package alone may not be enough. Check any existing remote inference configuration, as the converter may send documents to that service.
